```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

barcode_colours <- c("maroon4",
                     "steelblue4",
                     "lightskyblue",
                     "olivedrab1",
                     "darkolivegreen")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(scipen = 999)
```



```{r}
barcodes_unique <- read_tsv("all_BLAST_top5.tsv", col_names = F) %>%
  dplyr::select("X1", "X2", "X3", "X7") %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    qseqid = X1,
    qseqs_length = X2,
    sseqid = X3,
    taxid = X7
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    #some regexing to get separated out information
    qseqid = gsub("BWplate", "Garden", qseqid),
    qseqid = gsub("day", "Lakes", qseqid),
    dataset = str_extract(qseqid, "Lakes[0-9]|Garden[0-9]"),
    gb_num = str_extract(sseqid, "(?<=(gb|emb)\\|)[^|]+"),
    # needed for taxID info
    sseqid = stringr::str_extract(sseqid, "(?<=gi\\|)[^|]+"),
    readcount = gsub("readcount_", "", (str_extract(
      qseqid, "readcount_[0-9]+"
    ))),
    readcount = as.numeric(readcount),
    sample = paste0(
      stringr::str_extract(qseqid, "SP27_[0-9]+_SP5_[0-9]+"),
      "_",
      dataset
    ),
    # the adapters are repeated per dataset so pasting them together keeps things individual
    barcode = case_when(
      # what barcode is this?
      grepl("28S", qseqid) ~ "28S",
      grepl("18S", qseqid) ~ "18S",
      TRUE ~ "COI"
    ),
    primer_set = case_when(
      # which primers were used?
      barcode == "COI" & qseqs_length <= 499 ~ "Sauron",
      barcode == "COI" & qseqs_length >= 500 ~ "Moorea",
      barcode == "28S" & qseqs_length <= 2499 ~ "18S+",
      barcode == "28S" &
        qseqs_length >= 2500 ~ "28S_solo",
      barcode == "18S" ~ "18S+",
      TRUE ~ "?"
    )
   ) %>% 
  mutate(primer_barcode = paste(barcode, ",", primer_set)) %>% 
  distinct(qseqid, primer_barcode, readcount, dataset, sample)
```


```{r}
# For each primer_barcode, count barcodes with readcount >= x
dropoff_df <- barcodes_unique %>%
  group_by(primer_barcode) %>%
  arrange(readcount, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(n_remaining = n() - row_number() + 1) %>%   # barcodes with readcount >= this value
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(primer_barcode, readcount) %>%
  summarise(n_remaining = max(n_remaining), .groups = "drop") %>%  # collapse ties
  group_by(primer_barcode) %>%
  mutate(prop_remaining = n_remaining / max(n_remaining)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot exact counts
ggplot(dropoff_df, aes(readcount, n_remaining, colour = primer_barcode)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(10, 100, 1000),
    labels = c(10, 100, 1000))+
  scale_color_manual(values = barcode_colours)+
  labs(x = "Minimum read count (read depth threshold, log 10 scale)",
       y = "Number of barcodes retained",
       colour = "Primer / barcode",
       title = "Exact counts") +
  theme_minimal()

# Proportion version which makes coi even with others
ggplot(dropoff_df, aes(readcount, prop_remaining, colour = primer_barcode)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(10, 100, 1000),
    labels = c(10, 100, 1000))+
  scale_color_manual(values = barcode_colours)+
  labs(x = "Minimum read count, log 10 scale", 
       y = "Proportion of barcodes retained",
       colour = "Primer / barcode",
       title = "Proportions") +
  theme_minimal()

# Facet by dataset
dropoff_df_by_dataset <- barcodes_unique %>%
  group_by(primer_barcode, dataset) %>%
  arrange(readcount, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(n_remaining = n() - row_number() + 1) %>%   # barcodes with readcount >= this value
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(primer_barcode, readcount, dataset) %>%
  summarise(n_remaining = max(n_remaining), .groups = "drop") %>%  # collapse ties
  group_by(primer_barcode) %>%
  mutate(prop_remaining = n_remaining / max(n_remaining)) %>%
  ungroup()

# exact counts
ggplot(dropoff_df_by_dataset, aes(readcount, n_remaining, colour = primer_barcode)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(10, 100, 1000),
    labels = c(10, 100, 1000))+
  scale_color_manual(values = barcode_colours)+
  labs(x = "Minimum read count (read depth threshold, log 10 scale)",
       y = "Number of barcodes retained",
       colour = "Primer / barcode",
       title = "Exact counts, faceted by dataset") +
  theme_minimal()+
  facet_wrap(~dataset)

# proportion
ggplot(dropoff_df_by_dataset, aes(readcount, prop_remaining, colour = primer_barcode)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(10, 100, 1000),
    labels = c(10, 100, 1000))+
  scale_color_manual(values = barcode_colours)+
  labs(x = "Minimum read count", 
       y = "Proportion of barcodes retained",
       colour = "Primer / barcode",
       title = "Proportions, faceted by dataset") +
  theme_minimal()+
  facet_wrap(~dataset)
```
```{r}
min_coverage         <- 20  # reads a contig needs to count as "covered"
fractions_of_reads <- 2^(-seq(0, 6, by = 0.2))

barcodes_passing_full_depth <- barcodes_unique %>%
  filter(readcount >= min_coverage) # filter contigs under threshold

retention_by_depth_raw <- expand_grid(barcodes_passing_full_depth,
                                  fraction_of_reads = fractions_of_reads) %>%
  mutate(reads_after_subsampling = readcount * fraction_of_reads,           # reads left at this fraction
         still_covered           = reads_after_subsampling >= min_coverage) %>%  # TRUE/FALSE per barcode
  group_by(primer_barcode, fraction_of_reads) %>%
  summarise(prop_barcodes_retained = mean(still_covered),                   # proportion of TRUE
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(retention_by_depth_raw,
       aes(x = fraction_of_reads, 
           y = prop_barcodes_retained, 
           colour = primer_barcode)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    transform = scales::transform_compose("log2", "reverse"),   # full depth on the left
    breaks    = 2^(-(0:6)),
    labels    = scales::percent
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_color_manual(values = barcode_colours) +
  labs(x      = "Reads retained after subsampling (% of full depth)",
       y      = paste0("Barcodes still with ≥", min_coverage, "x coverage"),
       colour = "Primer / barcode") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
# Expected proportion retained at each subsampling fraction
retention_by_depth_prob <- expand_grid(barcodes_passing_full_depth,
                                  fraction_of_reads = fractions_of_reads) %>% # For each contig & fraction, the number of reads kept is readcount + fraction
  mutate(prob_still_covered = pbinom(min_coverage - 1,
                                     size       = readcount,
                                     prob       = fraction_of_reads,
                                     lower.tail = FALSE)) %>% # probability of having >= min_coverage = upper tail of distribution.
  group_by(primer_barcode, fraction_of_reads) %>%
  summarise(prop_barcodes_retained = mean(prob_still_covered), # averaging across barcodes gives the expected proportion retained
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(retention_by_depth_prob,
       aes(x = fraction_of_reads, 
           y = prop_barcodes_retained, 
           colour = primer_barcode)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    transform = scales::transform_compose("log2", "reverse"),   # full depth on the left
    breaks    = 2^(-(0:7)),
    labels    = scales::percent
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_color_manual(values = barcode_colours) +
  labs(x      = "Reads retained after subsampling (% of full depth)",
       y      = paste0("Barcodes still with ≥", min_coverage, "x coverage"),
       colour = "Primer / barcode") +
  theme_minimal()
```
